main_measure.name: mean 48-bar directional excess return over the coin's normal drift
main_measure.threshold: confirm: t of the mean >= +2 with top-minus-bottom half above 0; reject: t <= -2; at least 100 cases

supporting_check.name: top half minus bottom half (median |forecast|) mean directional excess return

decided_by: The main mean's t is +2 or more and the top half minus bottom half is above 0.
reading: Cases are all trending bars with nonzero forecast and a full 48-bar forward return in the same window, the drift is each coin's mean non-overlapping 48-bar return over all its windows, and the median split puts |forecast| > median in the top half and <= median in the bottom half.
